An administrator must not use an everyday human account for privileged work; privileged administrators must use a separate administrative account and a hardware security key, while their everyday account must not hold standing administrator privileges. [1]

The internal response target for a privacy request is 20 business days from the bank’s original receipt of the request. [2]

A teller’s manual account adjustment must be checked by an independent checker before posting. [1]

A CU 32 eligible travel meal is reimbursed in full, i.e., CU 32, and does not exceed the CU 40 daily meal cap. [2]
